tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt:
This summer, your theater group is performing the musical "Oscar Darling" at the Sabana Civic Center from August 14–17. As you know, tickets for your shows are very popular. You want to invite friends to attend and encourage them to book early.
Write an email to a friend:
Write as much as you can and in complete sentences.
bullets: Explain why the event is special (e.g., your involvement, the hard work behind it).
Mention exciting activities (e.g., live orchestra, post-show meetup, etc.).
Urge them to reserve tickets soon to avoid missing out.
tasks.subject: Invitation
tasks.sample:
Dear [Friend's Name],

I'm so excited to tell you that after months of rehearsals, my theater group is finally bringing "Oscar Darling" to life at the Sabana Civic Center from August 14–17! This show is extra special to me because I've been working as [your role, e.g., lead actor/set designer/choreographer], and I can't wait for you to see what we've created.

The performance will feature a live orchestra, breathtaking costumes, and even a post-show cast meet-and-greet on opening night! Trust me, you won’t want to miss it.

Tickets are selling fast—they always do for our shows—so book yours ASAP at [booking link/website]. Let me know which date you prefer, and we can even go together!

I’d love to celebrate this with you. Hope to see you there!

Warmly,
[Your Name]
[Your Contact Info, if needed]
tasks.title: Write an Email
